ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, from left to right, there is an input signal arrow entering the first box subsystem, and the box is labeled H1; then an arrow connects to the second box subsystem, and the box is labeled H2; then it is output by an arrow. Therefore the image shows that H1 and H2 are connected in series/cascade. Reasoning: The problem states that the group delays of two LTI subsystems H1 and H2 are τ1 and τ2 respectively. The total transfer function of the cascade system is H(ω)=H1(ω)H2(ω). The phases of the product add, so the total phase is φ(ω)=φ1(ω)+φ2(ω). The group delay is defined as τg(ω)=-dφ(ω)/dω, therefore the total group delay is -d[φ1(ω)+φ2(ω)]/dω = -dφ1(ω)/dω - dφ2(ω)/dω = τ1 + τ2.
